summary: New Pacific Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing a news release reporting the signing of Administrative Mining Contracts (AMCs) for its Carangas Silver-Gold Project in Bolivia. The AMCs cover approximately 39 km, have a 30-year fixed term, and were signed with AJAM on August 21, 2026. The company also announced the commencement of a 30,000-metre drill program starting September 8, 2026, to upgrade mineral resources and support a feasibility study. This is a routine operational update regarding permitting and exploration progress. No special-situation transaction is involved, as the filing describes standard project advancement activities, including regulatory approvals and drilling plans.
